After the game, the President of the United States, Donald Trump, walked onto the field to {{hand over}} the trophy. chunks.text: Scientists have {{picked up}} the first signs of air around a small, rocky planet outside our solar system. The planet, called LHS 1140 b, sits about 48 light-years from Earth. It circles its star in the zone where the temperature could be right for water. This is [[a huge deal]], because a planet needs air to {{hold on to}} heat and to give life a chance. But the discovery did not {{end up}} being simple.

chunks.text: LHS 1140 b is a super-Earth, which means it is rocky like Earth but much bigger. To study it, a team at Harvard University {{set out}} to watch the planet with a powerful telescope in Chile. In 2024, they {{came across}} helium gas escaping from the top of the planet's air. The planet's star {{gives off}} strong radiation, and this slowly {{strips away}} the gas. For the scientists, it was a rare [[privilege]] to [[witness]] this so far from Earth.
